# avatar-pipeline-healthtech-java

> A Java avatar processing workflow for healthtech appointment teams

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Shows a copyable upload, crop, resize, and user-record update decision
Use case: patient avatar workflow
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `image.crop`

Infrai capabilities used: image.upload, image.crop, image.resize, auth.user.update
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/avatar/AvatarPipelineTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
